item.title: COVID was allowed to spread with 'deadly speed'
item.description: A lack of testing left the government "effectively blind" to COVID spreading across the UK, a report has found.
item.media:description: A member of NHS Track and Trace giving the thumbs up at a testing site in Hampshire. Pic: PA

item.title: Police 'examining' claims of women being trafficked by Epstein on King's Balmoral estate
item.description: Police are "examining" claims of women being trafficked by Jeffrey Epstein on the King's private Scottish estate, one of Britain's top cops has confirmed to Sky News.
item.media:description: Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell at the Balmoral estate. Pic: SDNY/ZUMA Press Wire/Shutterstock
